Name: CommandCheckVoucherHandleBeforeEdit
Content:
<![CDATA[
if @@view = 0 begin
  if @@action = 'Edit' begin
    declare @$checkVoucherHandle varchar(32)
    select @$checkVoucherHandle = status from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    if exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and xedit = 1) begin
      select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
      return
    end
    if (@@admin <> 1) and (@$checkVoucherHandle is not null) and exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
      if not exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysactionrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and action_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
      if exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysstatusrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and status_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and r_edit = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
]]>

Name: ScriptCurrency

  init: function(f) {
    this._currencyChangedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onCurrencyChanged);
    this._dateChangedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onDateChanged);
    this._currencySelectedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onCurrencySelected);
    f._currencyBehavior.addCurrencyHandler(this._currencyChangedHandler, this._dateChangedHandler, this._currencySelectedHandler);
  },
  dispose: function(f) {
    if (f._currencyBehavior) {
      if (this._currencyChangedHandler) {
        f._currencyBehavior.removeCurrencyHandler(this._currencyChangedHandler, this._dateChangedHandler, this._currencySelectedHandler);
        this._currencyChangedHandler = null;
        this._dateChangedHandler = null;
        this._currencySelectedHandler = null;
      }
      f._currencyBehavior.dispose();
    }
  },
]]>
